summary: Public projects created on 16 April 2026: 7 repos.
intro: Agent plugins for Claude Code covered purchase research, persistent user memory, GitHub discovery, skill authoring, and Typst document templates. Two repositories held bug reports and feature requests for Claude Code and research notes on skill creation. A separate tool remapped a generic USB button to F13 on Linux and Wayland.

projects.name: Agent Assisted Purchase Research Index
projects.description: Index of templates, agent skills, and demos for the pattern of using AI agents to drive consumer purchase research — spec-first, then product matching, then availability checks

projects.name: Claude Code Bugs And FRs
projects.description: Staging area for Claude Code bug reports and feature requests before filing upstream at anthropics/claude-code

projects.name: Claude User Memory Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: user memory and personalization workflow — recall, save, and inject persistent facts across sessions.

projects.name: GitHub Research Plugin
projects.description: Explore existing GitHub repositories before building something yourself. This plugin is focused exclusively on research and discovery — it does not perform any GitHub write operations.

projects.name: Skill Creation Research
projects.description: Open research workspace for Claude Code skill creation — patterns, best practices, skill authoring experiments

projects.name: Typst Document Generator Plugin
projects.description: Typst document templates as agent skills: generic built-in formats (docs, briefings, screenplay) plus a private overlay for your own

projects.name: USB Button Remap
projects.description: Remap a generic USB HID button (vendor 5131:2019) to F13 on Linux/Wayland using keyd
